# Reylong Machinery Co., Ltd.

> Taiwan-based manufacturer of plastic and packaging machinery: PP woven bag conversion lines, flexographic printing machines, eddy current non-ferrous metal separators, stand-up zipper pouch machines, and AI machine-intelligence retrofits. B2B industrial equipment, exported to clients in 30+ countries. Site available in English (default) and Spanish (/es).

## Products

- [Automatic PP Woven Bag Conversion Line (Printing-Tubing-Cutting-Sewing)](https://www.reylong.com/products/automatic-printing-tubing-cutting-sewing-line): complete woven bag conversion line, Eye-Mark dynamic error compensation, up to 220 pcs/min
- [6-Color Flexographic Roll-to-Roll Printing Machine](https://www.reylong.com/products/flexographic-printing-machine-6c): JLRPM-6800BO/6C for PP woven and laminated fabric, servo tension control, inter-color drying, 100 m/min
- [Eddy Current Non-Ferrous Metal Separator Line](https://www.reylong.com/products/eddy-current-non-ferrous-separator): recovers copper, aluminum and zinc from shredded plastic and mixed recycling streams
- [High-Speed Stand-Up Zipper Pouch Bag Making Machine](https://www.reylong.com/products/hp-l-2tzp600-stand-up-zipper-pouch-machine): five pouch styles on one platform, up to 220 pcs/min
- [AI-Powered Machine Intelligence Solutions](https://www.reylong.com/products/ai-machine-intelligence-solutions): edge AI vision inspection and predictive maintenance retrofits for existing lines
- [All products](https://www.reylong.com/products)

## Technical Guides

- [Print Registration Drift on PP Woven Fabric: A Diagnostic Guide](https://www.reylong.com/news/print-registration-drift-pp-woven-fabric): why registration on woven PP is a tension problem, and what AI vision can and cannot do today
- [Heat Seal Failures in Pouch Production: A Diagnostic Guide](https://www.reylong.com/news/heat-seal-strength-failure-diagnosis): four failure modes (false seal, burn-through, channel leak, random weak seals) and how to diagnose each
- [Cut-Length Drift on Woven Bag Lines](https://www.reylong.com/news/cut-length-drift-woven-bag-lines): why fixed-length cutting drifts and how Eye-Mark vision-to-servo compensation holds ±1 mm
- [AI Visual Inspection on Woven Bag Lines: What It Catches — and What It Misses](https://www.reylong.com/news/ai-visual-inspection-woven-bag-printing): CNN vision on textured woven substrates, recall vs precision, camera and lighting choices
- [Manual vs AI Inspection on Woven Bag Lines: An Honest Comparison](https://www.reylong.com/news/manual-vs-ai-inspection-woven-bag-lines): Sandia research on 20–30% human miss rates, the economics, and when manual inspection is still right
- [Retrofitting Edge AI Inspection onto an Existing Bag Line](https://www.reylong.com/news/retrofit-edge-ai-inspection-woven-bag-line): what gets installed, the ~50 reference samples, three integration depths
- [What Is Eddy Current Separation?](https://www.reylong.com/news/eddy-current-separation-guide): recovering non-ferrous metals from recycling lines
- [Water-Based Inks: The Sustainable Future of Flexographic Packaging Printing](https://www.reylong.com/news/water-based-inks-flexographic-printing-sustainable-packaging)
- [3-Side Seal vs. Stand-Up Zipper Pouch: Which Bag Format Is Right for Your Line?](https://www.reylong.com/news/3-side-seal-vs-stand-up-zipper-pouch)
- [All guides and news](https://www.reylong.com/news)
